title: The Coming Race
author: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron
description: "The Coming Race" by Baron Edward Bulwer Lytton Lytton is a novel published in 1871.
longDescription: When a traveler descends into a chasm and becomes trapped in a subterranean world, he discovers the Vril-ya—an advanced race with telepathic powers and mastery over a mysterious energy called "Vril." In their utopian society, women are stronger than men and pursue romantic partners aggressively. When two Vril-ya women fall in love with him, the narrator faces a dangerous dilemma that threatens his survival in this strange underground civilization.

authorInfo.bio: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron (1803–1873) is the author of The Coming Race. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
